    import { Cause, Data, Effect } from "effect"
    
    class NotFound extends Data.TaggedError("NotFound")<{}> {}
    class CustomNoSuchElement extends Data.TaggedError("NoSuchElementError")<{}> {}
    
    declare const canonical: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError>
    declare const withOther: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | NotFound>
    declare const custom: Effect.Effect<string, CustomNoSuchElement>

    declare const structural: Effect.Effect<string, { readonly _tag: "NoSuchElementError" }>
    declare const broadTag: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | { readonly _tag: string }>
    
    // MUST TRIGGER: the error channel is exactly Cause.NoSuchElementError
    export const exact = canonical.pipe(
      Effect.asSome,
      Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
